references.use: Executable enumeration calls. Interface information is report 0x02, subdevice i, response length SPIHID_DESC_MAX. Report descriptors start at i = 1 and use report 0x10, subdevice i, same length. The five-key set is 01/d0 plus 02/01, 10/01, 02/02, and 10/02.

references.use: SPIHID_DESC_MAX is 512. The 16-byte interface header is byte 1 interface, byte 5 country, little-endian input at offset 6, output at 8, control at 10, then name offset and length. spihid_process_iface_info copies those three lengths with le16_to_cpu and does not apply a 2038 ceiling. interface_num is not read; the slot is the requested subdevice. SPIHID_MAX_INPUT_REPORT_SIZE is 0x800 and is the Linux HID buffer, not a size this helper allocates. The local payload cap remains 2038. Zero advertised input stays a local refusal.
